key_insight: BES-YOLO11 improves SEM defect segmentation in APS thermal barrier coatings by combining stronger multi-scale feature fusion with a lighter segmentation head for better accuracy and speed.
engineering_relevance: The method supports faster, more reliable microscopic inspection of coating defects, helping quantify microstructure quality in thermal spray manufacturing workflows.
method: BRB-FPN enhances cross-scale feature fusion and boundary-aware contour localization.
ESCH reduces parameters and FLOPs while accelerating inference.
Built on YOLO11-seg without extra training tricks.
evidence_signal: On a self-constructed APS-TBC SEM defect dataset, the method improved Mask mAP@50 by 6.9%, Mask mAP@50:95 by 4.4%, and recall by 5.5% over the baseline while also increasing FPS.
watch_item: Performance is demonstrated on a self-built dataset, so broader validation across other coating types, imaging conditions, and defect classes is still needed.
paper_title: Defect Characterization and Segmentation in APS Thermal Barrier Coatings SEM Images Using BES-YOLO11
